Q5779.reason: Peripheral cannulas not in continuous use are commonly flushed at least every 8 hours (some guidance says 12), so 8 hours is the best-supported choice.

Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3) a no-reserve auction bars withdrawal after bidding begins, which favors A, but the bid is only an offer that the auctioneer has not accepted, so I'm keeping D.

Q6156.reason: Under FRE 804(b)(1) the engineer is unavailable and the company had a similar motive and opportunity to cross-examine at the deposition, so it qualifies as former testimony.
